items.title: Is Broadcom (AVGO) Undervalued As A 6% Drop Reopens The Valuation Debate?
items.summary: Broadcom (AVGO) is back in focus after the stock fell almost 6% on Friday, its sharpest single day decline in over two months. items.title: Can Qualcomm's Advanced Snapdragon Mobile Portfolio Boost Profits?
items.summary: QCOM is expanding its smartphone reach with Snapdragon platforms, AI capabilities and power-efficient chips for next-generation devices.

items.title: Nvidia and Broadcom earnings: TD Cowen says earnings won’t settle big questions
items.summary: Investing.com -- TD Cowen stated in a note on Tuesday that it sees upside to estimates across compute and networking semiconductors but is neutral heading into results from Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) and Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO), arguing the issues that matter most to investors will not be resolved this quarter.

items.title: Memory’s Cyclicality is No More, So I Keep Loading Up on Micron
items.summary: Micron burned shareholders for decades through boom-bust cycles that seemed as inevitable as the seasons, but one structural shift in how AI consumes memory has the author convinced those cycles are gone and keeps triggering another buy.

items.title: Marvell Technology Drops 6% as Rising Treasury Yields Swamp a Bullish UBS AI Note
items.summary: A bullish UBS note on Marvell's AI business landed Tuesday morning, and the stock still cratered 6%. The reason has nothing to do with silicon and everything to do with what happened in the bond market.

items.title: Apple’s Anti-AI Position Suddenly Becomes Stock Market Baggage
items.summary: Apple Inc.’s status as an anti-artificial intelligence play helped the stock tear through the first half of the year as investors grew skeptical of the AI trade. But that sentiment has flipped, and the shares are suddenly struggling.

items.title: Broadcom's AI Financing Could Reach $370 Billion. But It's Not as Bad as It Sounds.
items.summary: The number rattling the market is a modeled ceiling on future deals. The number the chipmaker has actually signed is much smaller — for now.
